# USD in CAD and CAD in USD, both on 2026-02-02, in one file.
#
# GnuCash keeps one price a day for two currencies, whichever way round they
# are written (Q-041, table 1), so it would keep one of these and which one
# would depend on their order in the file.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; both blocks are refused.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_second_price_on_one_day_is_refused.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.36"
	source: "user:price"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-02-02 15:00:00 +0000"
	value: "0.735"
	source: "user:price"
	type: "last"
